create_DeformModel: create a DeformModel instance with optional blender or 6dof flags for deformation network
run_step_method: run the step method to compute deformation on xyz coordinates with time embeddings
build_train_setting: build training settings by configuring the Adam optimizer and exponential learning rate scheduler
save_weights_method: save the deform network weights to a specified model path and iteration directory
load_weights_method: load deform network weights from a saved checkpoint at a given iteration or the latest
